At DeliBarn, you will join an innovative, international, and growing food production company where you can build a long-term career. We offer: Starting gross hourly wage of €17.16 14% shift allowance on top of every worked hour in the two-shift system Additional allowance for working in a chilled environment of €0.10 – €0.62 per hour 25 holidays 8% holiday allowance Travel allowance Safety shoes and work clothing provided Flexible working opportunities on Saturdays and public holidays A long-term position with the possibility of a permanent contract Training and guidance on the job A modern and professional working environment Opportunities to develop your technical skills Career and growth opportunities within the organization Functieomschrijving As an Operator, you work independently and keep a close eye on the entire production process. You know when adjustments are needed and take action when something is not running as it should. Your responsibilities include: Operating production lines in the slicing department Receiving and checking incoming raw materials Supplying and removing products during the production process Setting up, adjusting and starting production lines and machinesChanging over machines and production lines when required Monitoring the production process and making adjustments when necessary Identifying and solving minor production disruptions Performing visual inspections and quality checks Making sure products meet the required quality standards Following hygiene, food safety, health and safety procedures Keeping your work area clean, safe and organized You’ll work in a cooled and highly hygienic production environment. Within DeliBarn, innovation, quality, teamwork, and personal development are highly valued. The company continues to invest in modern technology and efficient production processes, giving employees the opportunity to learn, develop their skills, and grow within the organization. Apply today and become part of the DeliBarn team in Wijchen. Your next career step could start here!
